Discover Coastal Dream, your premier Seagrove Beach vacation rental and ultimate 7-bedroom luxury 30A rental at 292 Williams Street, Santa Rosa Beach, Florida —a brand-new 2021 build spanning 5,068 square feet across three stories of coastal elegance. Nestled just one block from pristine Eastern Lake beach access in the heart of charming Seagrove Beach along Florida's coveted 30A corridor, this Gulf Coast beach house blends timeless Old Florida charm with modern sophistication. Sleeps up to 20 guests in plush, thoughtfully designed suites, making it the perfect Florida Gulf Coast vacation home for multigenerational family reunions, lively bachelorette getaways, or serene snowbird retreats. Home Highlights for Your Seagrove Beach Getaway

Why Coastal Dream is Your Top Seagrove Beach Vacation Rental Choice
Imagine waking to the gentle Gulf breeze in this Florida beach house rental, just steps from uncrowded beaches where turquoise waves meet powdery white sand. With elevator ease, generous space, and every detail polished for luxury—from high-thread-count sheets to Sonos audio system-synced tunes—it's the ultimate 7-bedroom beach house on 30A.
